done.why: I had seen the opening and killed the troll in one blow. There was no clear goal, so I stopped.

about: A changed version of Zork. The house and cellar are familiar, but south of the cellar are a chasm edge, a gallery and a studio. You collect things and fight a troll.

moments.note: South of the cellar led to a chasm, a gallery and a studio, not what I expected.
The chimney refused me because of what I was carrying, with an odd 'you, your lamp and one thing more' limit.
Typing several directions in one line was not understood.
The troll died in one blow.

wished: A hint about what I was supposed to be doing.
To put the treasures somewhere safe, such as the trophy case.

lines.why: Taking things was easy, which suited a new player.

lines.line: The chimney has room for you, your lamp and one thing more, and not an inch besides.
lines.why: It explained clearly why I was blocked.

fun.why: Easy and quick, but I had no sense of direction.

engagement.why: The new rooms were interesting, but I stopped early.

difficulty.why: Everything worked the first time, and the troll was trivial.

interestingness.why: The changed map made it feel different from what I half knew.

prose.why: The room descriptions were clear and brief.
